pull_request.title: Calorimeter: compare LAr and Si-W raw resolution versus eta and phi
pull_request.head: codex/ecal-raw-angular-restored
pull_request.body:
Adds the requested side-by-side raw energy-resolution plots versus signed eta and full phi: **15 bins, LAr solid, Si-W dotted**. Uses the selected restored 1.8 mm Pb LAr baseline and matching staggered Si-W 10,000-electron sample, retaining all events, zeros and tails.

![Raw energy resolution](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/ecal-raw-angular-restored/docs/validation/ecal-raw-angular/figures/raw-energy-resolution.png?raw=true)

Width = sample SD(Eraw/Etrue)/mean(Eraw/Etrue), averaged over 10-80 GeV in ECAL-only B=0 transport. Pointwise 95% intervals use 1000 shared event bootstraps. Includes PDF/SVG/PNG, compact bin statistics, full 60-variable covariance, hashes and exact reproduction recipe. No new transport, calibration or geometry change; the separate 400 mm-gap prototype is not this 10k sample.

Validation: frozen source/ledger/receipt/readback/geometry identities pass; all 60 bin means/SDs/widths/counts/zeros independently match a standard-library statistics audit; covariance finite/symmetric/positive semidefinite; five comparison tests pass; inventory and session validation pass; PNG visually inspected; staged whitespace and new-object sizes checked. Exact current-turn usage is unavailable.

Targets codex/restored-lar-em-baseline because the selected baseline stack is not on main yet. Related DES-032/033 and PR150. Draft delivery follows the standing human instruction recorded in AGENTS.md (2026-11-06) and its original paired session. No design sign-off, ready-for-review action or merge.

events.text:
Added optional --sector-half-width-percent15 to the exact-source-bound analysis.
Phi is signed folded SiWphase,100*folded_phi/(pi/8), restricted to[-15,+15]percent.
The same coordinate is applied to both models; it is not LAr electrode symmetry.
No reflection or response-based selection. Phi retains3009matched events per
model and excludes6991outside the directional window. All selected zeros/tails
remain. Eta retains all10000events; every eta bin record is exactly unchanged.
Shared whole-event bootstrap still samples the original10000IDs before applying
projection masks, preserving correlations between inclusive eta and selected phi.
Fifteen points/panel, LAr solid/SiW dotted and prescribed ECALcolor retained.
Original full-phi figure/data remain at the starting Git revision; omitting the
optional window reproduces that analysis. Updated PNG/PDF/SVG, compact bin data,
covariance, hashes, README recipe and inventory. No detector/design sign-off.
